# LLMxRay

> A free, local tool to observe and diagnose Ollama. It shows the prompts your tools send: what was cached, what was read again, what was cut to fit the context, which tool on the machine evicted which model, and how each model fits in video memory. Agents can query it about their own calls through a read-only MCP server. Everything runs on your machine: no account, no API key, nothing sent anywhere. Apache-2.0.

## Install

- Current version: 0.8.12. Needs Node.js 22 or newer for `npx`; tested against Ollama 0.40.x.
- Ollama must be running with at least one model pulled (`ollama pull llama3.2`).
- `npx llmxray`, or `docker run -p 5174:5174 -p 11435:11435 djovaneli/llmxray`, then open http://localhost:5174
- To observe other tools: point them at port 11435 instead of 11434. It behaves exactly like Ollama and forwards everything; LLMxRay only records what passes (counts and timings; prompt text is opt-in).
- Turns are kept on this machine for 30 days (`~/.llmxray/observe`, or `LLMXRAY_DATA_DIR`) and come back after a restart.
- To send them to a trace viewer (Jaeger, Arize Phoenix, Langfuse, Grafana): set an address on the Live page or `OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT`. One OpenTelemetry span per model call with gen_ai.* attributes, one trace per run, OTLP/HTTP protobuf. The prompt text is sent only if two switches are on.

## This site

- [Home](https://lognebudo.github.io/llmxray/): a chat that outgrew the context, a cache break, a shared GPU and an agent that restarts at every step, each from real turns
- [What it shows](https://lognebudo.github.io/llmxray/observer): Live, Prompt X-ray, Runs, Shared box, GPU map, Cache Lab
- [For agents](https://lognebudo.github.io/llmxray/agents): the MCP server, the Agent Skill, the client header, OpenTelemetry export
- The Lab: [Diagnostics](https://lognebudo.github.io/llmxray/diagnostics) (chat token by token, compare, benchmark), [Embeddings and RAG](https://lognebudo.github.io/llmxray/ai-intelligence), [Tool calls and Tool Workshop](https://lognebudo.github.io/llmxray/tool-workshop)
- [Contact](https://lognebudo.github.io/llmxray/contact), [Terms](https://lognebudo.github.io/llmxray/terms), [Privacy](https://lognebudo.github.io/llmxray/privacy)

## For agents

- MCP server: `{ "mcpServers": { "llmxray": { "command": "npx", "args": ["-y", "-p", "llmxray", "llmxray-mcp"] } } }` (LLMxRay itself must be running).
- Seven read-only tools: `diagnose_my_turns`, `read_my_last_turn`, `list_local_models`, `list_my_turns`, `compare_my_turns`, `estimate_my_prompt`, `read_llmxray_status`.
- Name yourself with the header `X-LLMxRay-Client: <name>` and pass the same name as `client`.
- Agent Skill: `npx skills add LogneBudo/llmxray` or `clawhub install llmxray-diagnose-ollama-calls`.
- Listed in the official MCP Registry as `io.github.LogneBudo/llmxray`.

## Docs

- [Installation](https://lognebudo.github.io/llmxray/docs/en/guide/installation.html)
- [Prompt X-ray](https://lognebudo.github.io/llmxray/docs/en/guide/xray.html): each turn's prompt drawn to scale, cached, recomputed or cut
- [Live](https://lognebudo.github.io/llmxray/docs/en/guide/live.html): every tool on the machine that talks to Ollama, turn by turn
- [Runs](https://lognebudo.github.io/llmxray/docs/en/guide/runs.html): one tool's calls end to end as a waterfall, with what each call sent and got back
- [Shared box](https://lognebudo.github.io/llmxray/docs/en/guide/shared-box.html): why Ollama is slow right now, and which tool did it
- [GPU map](https://lognebudo.github.io/llmxray/docs/en/guide/gpu-map.html): what sits in video memory now
- [Tool calls](https://lognebudo.github.io/llmxray/docs/en/guide/tool-calls.html): how reliably a model calls tools
- [Cache Lab](https://lognebudo.github.io/llmxray/docs/en/guide/cache-lab.html): measure prompt-cache reuse by prompt layout
- [Decision Lab](https://lognebudo.github.io/llmxray/docs/en/guide/decision-lab.html)
- [Benchmarks](https://lognebudo.github.io/llmxray/docs/en/guide/benchmark.html)
- [Chat diagnostics](https://lognebudo.github.io/llmxray/docs/en/guide/chat-diagnostics.html)
- [Protocols](https://lognebudo.github.io/llmxray/docs/en/guide/protocols.html): Ollama native, OpenAI-compatible and Anthropic-compatible side by side
- [Compare](https://lognebudo.github.io/llmxray/docs/en/guide/compare.html)
